basis: Andrew, 5 Nov 2026 (10:0x AEST): "Leaving at  10am  142514". 142514 is AA's only unit (Coates portable building; ticked Ready 4 Nov; no booking on the record; read 10:08 AEST, not already left), so AA left in full at 10:00 AEST on Thu 5 Nov 2026. Its fire extinguisher stays listed on AA as gear that goes with it. Recorded after 10:00, as a departure is only recorded once its time has come.
